name: io.github.zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp-illustrator
title: Illustrator MCP Server
description: Drive Adobe Illustrator from any MCP client: artwork, type, colour, effects, data and export.

environmentVariables.name: ILLUSTRATOR_APP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: macOS only: address a specific copy, e.g. "Adobe Illustrator 2025". Default: Illustrator by bundle id

environmentVariables.name: ILLUSTRATOR_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories allowed for file operations (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: ILLUSTRATOR_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for Illustrator before reporting that a dialog may be open. Default 120000
